title: Sharp one-bit norm comparison
statement: Let $q,a,b\in\mathbb R$ with $2<q$. For a uniformly chosen sign $\varepsilon\in\{-1,1\}$, the $q$-norm of $a+b\varepsilon/\sqrt{q-1}$ is at most the $2$-norm of $a+b\varepsilon$.
